sample_html:
Customer Focus

Leaders in GoComet always keep customers in mind. This means first thinking about the customer experience and then working backwards. Work vigorously to earn and keep customer trust.

Speed

Leaders in GoComet have a bias for action. If faced with two scenarios, pick one which is faster to market and faster to feedback. Leaders choose the most critical challenges and opportunities and move with velocity after them.
